title: Project test fixtures blocked automatic worktree reclamation
observation: The previously passing full suite left 1,626 ignored files in the execution worktree. Inspection traced 1,618 files to repeated mkdtemp fixtures in tests/base-content-verification.test.mjs and tests/project-snapshot.test.mjs; neither fixture registered cleanup, so session-concurrency correctly refused to remove a worktree containing ignored data.
impact: The project could not complete automatic cleanup while generated test fixtures remained in the ignored scratch tree.
A task could appear clean under ordinary git status while cleanup was still unsafe.
reusable_value: Every node:test fixture written under project _work/scratch must register t.after cleanup for its exact mkdtemp root. Then tests remain isolated without leaving ignored files that block supervised worktree cleanup.
actions: Registered t.after(() => fs.rmSync(root, {recursive:true, force:true})) for the two mkdtemp fixtures.
The focused suites passed 8/8, and the new test runs removed their own scratch roots.
The complete project suite passed 217/217 after the cleanup fix; the _work/scratch directory count remained 88, so this suite left no new scratch roots.

After archiving the unique N1 before-manifest and failed-readback receipts, safely removed the 88 pre-existing test fixture directories; every target stayed inside this worktree and had no links, locks, or active test process.
